_doc: Performance budgets enforced by scripts/audit/{bundle-size,asset-budget,build-profile}.ts. Numbers are seeded from today's measurements (build on 2026-05-12) with headroom; tighten as the site stabilizes.

bundle._doc: Gzipped sizes of dist/_astro/*.{css,js} + dist/scripts/*.js. Today CSS total ~12.0 KB, JS ~10.9 KB (public scripts plus Astro islands; pagefind-search adds the 404 search recovery script).

assets._doc: Raster files in public/. If a PNG/JPG exceeds the threshold, it must have a WebP companion of the same stem or be listed in webpExemptions.

build._doc: Peak resident set size of pnpm build, in MB. Report-only (null): single-run peak RSS swings with machine load and GC timing — samples have ranged ~80–170 MB on the same tree — so a hard threshold flaps on noise instead of signalling a real regression. The durable signal is the trend in audits/build-stats.jsonl, where a sustained jump shows up. Set a number here to re-enable a hard local gate (build-profile.ts is local-only; not a CI merge gate).

runtime._doc: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize after page load + 5s settle, in MB. Chromium-only.
